note: Twelfth and last shop of the B07 covered arcade (glass skylight, honey limestone, dark oak joinery, as on the exterior): the trading hall and saleroom, with honey limestone and red brick walls, green iron columns, a long glass roof and a worn plank floor. LANDMARK: the tall carved oak auction rostrum at the far end, with the auctioneer. The doorway on the left shows the violet perfumery with its bottles (way back). Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right. Zoom: the market stalls down the side aisle (z1).
